alerts.reason: Big Lots’ consolidated net sales growth slowed from 17.97% YoY in October to 8.15% in January. If that 9.83-point quarterly slowdown repeats, growth would be about -1.7% in the intervening quarter and -11.5% in the target quarter beginning May 2, crossing -5% for the first time in that sequence. Fiscal 2020 comparable sales rose 16.1% (B), supporting the risk of a difficult year-over-year comparison.
